description.value:
Incredibly precise sniper rifle. Scavs are meticulous like that. Also fires lightning, if that matters to you.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Scout Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Bipod, Long Scope, Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link, Sniper Scout Barrel, Sniper Rifle Rechamber • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load custom Lightning Ammunition (250eb [Premium] per 10 rounds) that functions as Armor-Piercing, High Velocity, and EMP Ammunition that still deals damage. Whenever this weapon inflicts a Head Critical Injury, its user may choose to replace the Critical Injury effect with a Lightning Blast that functions as a 4d6 damage Improved EMP Grenade that detonates in a 6x6m/yds (3x3 Squares) area centered on the victim. The Critical Injury’s Bonus Damage is still dealt. After this weapon is fired, an Action is required to work its bolt before it can be fired again. Requires BODY 10+, or BODY 8+ and being Prone, to wield unless Mounted.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Scout Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Long Scope, Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link, Sniper Scout Barrel, Sniper Rifle Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
